title: Apollo 14 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Fra Mauro, the Moon
place.basis: Latitude and longitude as published by NSSDCA, referenced to the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists Apollo 14: launched 31 January 1971, landed 5 February 1971 at Fra Mauro (3.646 S, 17.472 W).

tiers.everyday: Apollo 14 landed on the Moon on 5 February 1971 in Fra Mauro. NASA lists the site at 3.646 S, 17.472 W on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists a launch on 31 January 1971, 9.38 hours of moonwalk time, a 3.45 km traverse and 42.28 kg of samples. Coordinates use the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

unknowns: IAU Gazetteer name for this landing point: not looked up [UNKNOWN] (only the Apollo 11 name was checked)
